articles.title: Strategy’s STRC rebounds 30% as company builds cash reserve, bitcoin price stabilizes
articles.snippet: Bitcoin sales, what is now a $4 billion cash reserve, and a $975 million repurchase program, have supported STRC’s recovery.

articles.title: SpaceX extends decline to 11% on lockup expiration and capex spending fears
articles.snippet: The company reported no BTC sales in the second quarter, but shares fell before the open as investors focused on capital spending, free cash flow pressure and a looming insider lockup expiry.

articles.title: SpaceX tops Wall Street revenue forecast, posts $540 million loss on bitcoin holdings
articles.snippet: Elon Musk's space company posted its first earnings as a public company ahead of a major insider share unlock.

articles.title: Binance sues RedotPay over alleged $473 million user losses: Report
articles.snippet: Binance-linked companies sued RedotPay, accusing it of diverting more than 470,000 Binance Card users under a commercial deal and seeking nearly $473 million in damages.

articles.title: Boerse Stuttgart Digital, Tradias close European crypto merger
articles.snippet: The completed tie-up combines Boerse Stuttgart Digital’s custody business with Tradias’ trading operations under a joint management team.
